newsitem.title: EGYPT: Nile Pharmaceuticals profits up 49 pct in 95/96.
newsitem.headline: Nile Pharmaceuticals profits up 49 pct in 95/96.

text.p: Majority state-owned Nile Pharmaceuticals and Chemical Industries said on Wednesday it made net profits of 29.018 million pounds ($8.5 million) in the financial year 1995/96, up 48.9 percent on 19.494 million pounds in the previous year.
The financial year ends on June 30.
The profits are equivalent to 9.67 pounds for each of the three million shares, which last traded at 51.50 pounds.
Net sales also increased to 180.259 million pounds last year from 162.948 million in 1994/95, it said.
The firm predicted that that in the current year 1996/7 net after-tax profits would be 29.060 million pounds and sales would reach 207.800 million.
Last year, as part of its privatisation programme, the state sold off 600,000 shares or 20 percent of the firm -- 300,000 to the public at 56.70 pounds a share and 300,000 to employees.
